room.name: sewer_main
room.physical_layout_note: 600ground metatile placements +57foreground placements; no room/collision/actor-anchor movement is needed for any concept.

features.label: Gray retaining brick wall
Raised side masonry
Walkable damp gray brick/flagstone floor
Central flowing sewage stream and scum
Near bank lip above the stream
Far bank lip below the stream
Rail/post foreground along north bank
Narrow central usable bridge with landings
Lower foreground railing
Lower coping and hanging lichen
Lower dark water and moving reflections
Large barred wall outfall, waterfall and basin
Functional ladder, dark aperture and warm arch
Horizontal brass pipe with couplings
Vertical brass wall pipe with couplings
Peddler market awning, counter and supports
Counter bottles / displayed wares
Keeper/wizard rug
Keeper shelf and animated brass candles
Two wooden crates and a barrel
Grease/lichen deposited below pipes and banks
Oily floor puddles
Small corroded sewage spout pouring into stream
Walkable lower barred drain / grate
Small art-authored animated highlights

implementation_notes: Each swh_000..swh_369 is an exact native16x16metatile ID, not an independent semantic object. Large fixtures consist of several IDs.
Five full concepts must replace every active ID/frame while keeping type/coll/prop metadata, layout and object anchors stable.
Reuse repeated ground IDs only for reusable material panels. Their original occurrence positions can span unrelated visual regions.
Keep overlay transparency and existing occlusion. North rail posts and counter face foreground must not become opaque floor squares.

Only38active IDs animate; whole-room source-phase changes are invisible when a cropped ID has one declared frame. Author flowing water into the actual declared animated IDs, or explicitly review an animation-contract extension.
The existing keeper palette pulses only indices13/14. New wizard cloth must not use those indices if the pulse is preserved; reserve them for flame.
Keep wisp body-relative position aligned to actual staff tip, or change WISP_AT consistently in all render paths.
No enemy/chest/switch/locked-door static actors are authored in the Drain room. Its four object descriptors are spawn, forest exit, wizard and merchant.
Native hardware may load source sheets for shared gameplay tools even when they are not visible. Loaded is different from spawned/visible.
